newsitem.title: USA: Arcadia Financial closes warehousing pact.
newsitem.headline: Arcadia Financial closes warehousing pact.

text.p: Arcadia Financial Ltd said Friday it closed on a $273 million financial warehousing agreement agented by J.P. Morgan.
The warehouse facility is a commercial paper conduit and will replace the previous $210 million J.P. Morgan facility. This brings Arcadia's total warehouse capacity to approximately $575 million.
This facility will be used to finance the daily purchase of automobile receivables prior to securitization.
Arcadia Financial is a consumer financial services company specializing in purchasing, selling and servicing retail installment contracts for new and used automobiles.
